metadata.csv_vs_api_fling_check: 0 mismatches in the first 200 cached API items cross-checked against items.csv fling_power
metadata.csv_vs_api_flags_check: 0 differences in attributes/flags on all cached API items cross-checked at build prep time
metadata.key_group_rule: category in {gameplay, plot-advancement, event-items} (PokeAPI categories holding key/story items such as bicycle, mega-ring, dynamax-band)
notes: Cost comes from the CSV cost column. The live PokeAPI item endpoint has no cost field (only per-version prices); cost 0 in the CSV means not purchasable / no buy price, not a free item.
Neither PokeAPI (CSV or API) nor Showdown provides a held_effect field; held_effect is null on every entry and held behaviour is in effect_full/effect_short.
Generations for PokeAPI items come from item_game_indices.csv; entries with none are generations ['unknown']. Showdown-only entries use the Showdown gen field (intro generation).

Sprite URLs follow the PokeAPI pattern raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/sprites/master/sprites/items/<identifier>.png. No item images were bulk-downloaded; only URLs are indexed (see items_sprites_index.json). Sample verification results are in items_sprites_verification.json.
Effect text: 955 PokeAPI items from CSV prose; the rest from API effect_entries where the API has English text; items with no English effect text in either source have null effect fields.
Showdown function-valued fields are preserved as {"__function__": true} markers exactly as in the source; no code was executed.

PokeAPI lists the identifier roseli-berry twice (id 723 cost 80 and id 2279 cost 200); both official rows are kept as separate entries, flagged with duplicate_identifier_note. No other identifier is duplicated.

PokeAPI '--held'/'--<variant>' suffixed identifiers (e.g. normalium-z--held, dna-splicers--merge/--split) are kept as their own items; Showdown keys matching only after stripping '--held' are merged, other '--' variants are left unmerged and listed in showdown_unmatched_ambiguous rather than forced.

items.effect_short: Held: Half the experience from a battle is split between Pokémon holding this item.
items.effect_full:
Held
:   Experience is split across two groups: Pokémon who participated in battle, and Pokémon holding this item. ignored; thus, if a single Pokémon is holding this item and the only Pokémon who battled faints from Explosion, the holder will gain full experience.
